import gradio as gr

# 🧠 Prediction function for Gradio
def predict_calories(Gender, Age, Height, Weight, Duration, Heart_Rate, Body_Temp):
    input_df = pd.DataFrame({
        "Gender": [Gender],
        "Age": [float(Age)],
        "Height": [float(Height)],
        "Weight": [float(Weight)],
        "Duration": [float(Duration)],
        "Heart_Rate": [float(Heart_Rate)],
        "Body_Temp": [float(Body_Temp)]
    })
    
    prediction = pipeline.predict(input_df)[0]
    return f"🔥 Estimated Calories Burned: {prediction:.2f}"

# 🎨 Gradio Interface
demo = gr.Interface(
    fn=predict_calories,
    inputs=[
        gr.Radio(["male", "female"], label="Gender"),
        gr.Number(label="Age"),
        gr.Number(label="Height (in cm)"),
        gr.Number(label="Weight (in kg)"),
        gr.Number(label="Duration (in minutes)"),
        gr.Number(label="Heart Rate"),
        gr.Number(label="Body Temperature (°F)")
    ],
    outputs=gr.Text(label="Calories Burned"),
    title="🏋️‍♀️ Calories Burn Prediction App",
    description="Enter the values to predict how many calories you may burn."
)

demo.launch()

import gradio as gr
import pandas as pd
import pickle
# Load the saved model
with open('pipeline_model.pkl', 'rb') as f:
    pipeline = pickle.load(f)
# Define the prediction function
def predict_calories(Gender, Age, Height, Weight, Duration, Heart_Rate, Body_Temp):
    # Convert input to dataframe
    sample = pd.DataFrame({
        "Gender": [Gender],
        "Age": [Age],
        "Height": [Height],
        "Weight": [Weight],
        "Duration": [Duration],
        "Heart_Rate": [Heart_Rate],
        "Body_Temp": [Body_Temp]
    })
    # Make prediction
    result = pipeline.predict(sample)[0]
    return f"Predicted Calories Burned: {result:.2f}"
# Create Gradio Interface
with gr.Blocks() as demo:
    # Define input components
    gender = gr.Dropdown(choices=["Male", "Female"], label="Gender")
    age = gr.Slider(minimum=10, maximum=100, value=21, label="Age")
    height = gr.Slider(minimum=100, maximum=250, value=165, label="Height (in cm)")
    weight = gr.Slider(minimum=30, maximum=200, value=50, label="Weight (in kg)")
    duration = gr.Slider(minimum=5, maximum=120, value=50, label="Duration (in minutes)")
    heart_rate = gr.Slider(minimum=60, maximum=200, value=140, label="Heart Rate (bpm)")
    body_temp = gr.Slider(minimum=90, maximum=104, value=99.1, label="Body Temperature (°F)")
    # Define the output component as Textbox
    output = gr.Textbox(label="Calories Prediction")
    # Define the Submit button
    submit_button = gr.Button("Submit")
    # Define the action for the button click
    submit_button.click(fn=predict_calories, inputs=[gender, age, height, weight, duration, heart_rate, body_temp], outputs=output)
# Launch the Gradio interface
demo.launch(share=True)
